tactical_principles: gegenpressing — counter-press within seconds of losing the ball to win it back high up the pitch
vertical, direct transitions that attack space immediately rather than resetting possession
high emotional intensity and relentless work-rate as a deliberate tactical weapon
signature_phrases: win it back in five seconds
